home.howItWorksDesc: A transparent 4-step path to finding and applying for government citizen benefits.
home.step1Desc: Search across state and central departments with comprehensive criteria and document checklists.
home.step2Desc: Provide minimal demographic information through our rule-based engine to identify potential matching benefits.
home.step3Desc: Understand required documents, statutory fees, application procedures, and verification dates.
home.step4Desc: Direct one-click access to actual government portals (Aaple Sarkar, MahaDBT, MyScheme) to lodge your application.
home.whyJanSevaDesc: Empowering citizens with authentic, transparent, and accessible public service information.
home.feature1Desc: Every record points to actual government URLs and shows exact last-verified dates.
home.feature2Desc: Transparent eligibility checks based on published statutory criteria without guesswork.
home.feature3Desc: We do not store your personal Aadhaar, bank details, or sensitive financial data.
home.feature4Desc: Available in English, Hindi, and Marathi with clean semantic markup for screen readers.
home.officialResourcesDesc: Direct links to authorized central and Maharashtra state citizen delivery portals.

about.title: About JanSeva Connect
about.subtitle: Empowering citizens through transparent, accessible public service discovery and grievance support.
about.visionDesc: To bridge the gap between citizens and public governance by providing reliable, multilingual, and easy-to-understand information on public services and welfare schemes.
about.missionDesc: Enable every citizen—regardless of digital literacy or language—to understand their rightful entitlements, check preliminary scheme eligibility, and connect directly with official government portals.
about.disclaimerDesc: JanSeva Connect is an independent public-interest informational and grievance-support platform developed as part of a civic-tech initiative. It is NOT an official government department, agency, or authorized agent of any government ministry.
about.pillar1Desc: All listings reference verifiable official government sources with verification timestamps.
about.pillar2Desc: Full multilingual support across English, Hindi, and Marathi with responsive, high-contrast layouts.
about.pillar3Desc: We do not ask for or store sensitive credentials, Aadhaar tokens, or confidential bank details.
about.pillar4Desc: Clear eligibility reasoning helping citizens understand why they qualify for specific benefits.
